title: The Chromatin Regulator HMGA1a Undergoes Phase Separation in the Nucleus.
authors: Zhu, Hongjia; Narita, Masako; Joseph, Jerelle A; Krainer, Georg; Arter, William E; Olan, Ioana; Saar, Kadi L; Ermann, Niklas; Espinosa, Jorge R; Shen, Yi; Kuri, Masami Ando; Qi, Runzhang; Welsh, Timothy J; Collepardo-Guevara, Rosana; Narita, Masashi; Knowles, Tuomas P J
journal: Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
one_liner_zh: 该文结合机器学习建模与多尺度模拟，研究HMGA1a蛋白通过蛋白-DNA互作驱动相分离调控染色质，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-DNA互作机制与AI/模拟方法对本课题有借鉴价值。
abstract: The protein high mobility group A1 (HMGA1) is an important regulator of chromatin organization and function. However, the mechanisms by which it exerts its biological function are not fully understood. Here, we report that the HMGA isoform, HMGA1a, nucleates into foci that display liquid-like properties in the nucleus, and that the protein readily undergoes phase separation to form liquid condensates in vitro. By bringing together machine-leaning modelling, cellular and biophysical experiments and multiscale simulations, we demonstrate that phase separation of HMGA1a is promoted by protein-DNA interactions, and has the potential to be modulated by post-transcriptional effects such as phosphorylation. We further show that the intrinsically disordered C-terminal tail of HMGA1a significantly contributes to its phase separation through electrostatic interactions via AT hooks 2 and 3. Our work sheds light on HMGA1 phase separation as an emergent biophysical factor in regulating chromatin structure.
abstract_zh: 蛋白高迁移率族蛋白A1（HMGA1）是染色质组织与功能的重要调控因子。然而，其发挥生物学功能的具体机制尚未完全阐明。在此，我们报道HMGA1亚型HMGA1a在细胞核内聚集形成具有液体样特性的病灶，并且该蛋白在体外易于发生相分离（phase separation）以形成液体凝聚体。通过结合机器学习建模、细胞与生物物理实验以及多尺度模拟，我们证明HMGA1a的相分离由蛋白质-DNA相互作用促进，并可能受到磷酸化等转录后效应的调控。我们进一步表明，HMGA1a的内在无序C末端尾部通过AT钩2和3的静电相互作用显著促进其相分离。我们的工作揭示了HMGA1相分离作为调控染色质结构的新兴生物物理因素。
